reference: independent pure-Python journal reader (python/tests/parity/test_journald.py); systemd/journalctl not available on Windows
notes: 165 MESSAGE fields are XZ-compressed: the reference decodes them with lzma, Veritas reports them as unsupported_fields (no XZ decoder in the Rust crate). ZSTD data objects (user-1000.journal) are unsupported by both. The dirty journal (.journal~) has 45 entry-array references to zeroed objects that both readers skip.
